reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: FOREX trading scam
reports.description: I first met a woman (name Lisa Smith) on the Tinder dating app around May 4, 2021. Our conversations soon migrated to the WhatsApp messaging app where we would text. She said she lived in Los Angeles but was temporarily residing in  Las Vegas purchasing a jewelry store. Through casual conversation she mentioned she invests in the foreign currency exchange market using inside information provided by a financial advisor named John. I was intrigued and she urged me to get involved. She sent screenshots of some of her trades and the money in her brokerage account. Via her instructions, I opened a demo account using the MT4 currency trading app on 5/6/21. Whenever the advisor John would give her a notice she would contact me and we would make a trade lasting about 10 minutes once or twice a week. I opened a real account around 5/10/21through a brokerage named Iatfxwelshi with .01784 ($1000) bitcoin by transfer to a bitcoin address through my Kraken crypto currency account. I made 6 deposits totaling $31,000 from May 10 to May 26. John was spot on with all of his calls and on paper I was making huge profits on a percentage basis. All was good until May 27, 2021 when following John‚Äôs direction I entered a trade and immediately my account went negative. John said it was because my account was too small and it couldn‚Äôt withstand the fluctuation of the trade swing. Lisa said she had made over $150,000 on the same trade. John and Lisa both urged me to invest more money and that he would help make up the loss. I became suspicious and began asking for personal information about location of offices and home addresses and such. They both became very evasive at that point and stopped responding to my communications. That‚Äôs where we are now. I have not tried to contact either of them since June, 2021. The iatfxwelshi.com website is no longer functioning.
